frontier.hypothesis: Everything statement-level is now measured dead and the only live question is PROVENANCE: target's compile carried genuine hard_reg_conflicts on $a1 AND $a2 at both allocation points, and nothing in this function's honest value set supplies them.
frontier.mechanism: Ordering is dead in the 39-insn family (s4 H14/H15) and in the 38-insn family (s5 H17); expression spelling is inert (s5 H18); both parameter narrowings are dead (s4 H16, s5 H20); the volatile carve-out census is NEGATIVE (s2 H5); dead temporaries are a cheat and land in $v1 not $a3 anyway (s2 H7). s2 line-cited global.c: find_reg takes the lowest free hard reg (no REG_ALLOC_ORDER for MIPS in this tree) and prune_preferences can never deny a register the allocno itself prefers, so ONLY real conflicts can produce target's $a3/$t0 numbering.
frontier.next_probe: Switch modality to forensics / rederive. Is replay_camera_Init the tail of a larger original function, does it inline a callee whose values occupy $a1/$a2, or does the original TU's ordering leave those hard regs live at entry? Concrete first step: m2c the target and diff its allocno structure against the .greg dumps already banked in s1/rtl/ and s2/rtl/. Do NOT spend another session on statement order, expression spelling, or the permuter.

frontier.hypothesis: The permuter axis is now closed BY CONSTRUCTION, not merely by outcome, and a fifth campaign cannot help.
frontier.mechanism: s4 H12 proved the scorer is anti-correlated (registers priced at 5 while the entire residue IS register naming; the score-13 floor rates 650 while a sandbox-21 find rates 235). s5 H19 removes the last alternative explanation by reading randomizer.py: mutation is function-scoped, so the ~142k iterations were real. s5's third basin at 40.9k iterations produced no surviving construct. The scorer cannot be reweighted from a grind session (tools/ is outside the allowed surface).
frontier.next_probe: None on this axis. If a future session is nonetheless assigned permuter modality, it should record this closure and spend the session on the provenance question instead of a fifth campaign.

frontier.hypothesis: candidate.c's two /* FAKE */ pointer aliases survive a fresh layer-2 cheat-reviewer.
frontier.mechanism: pointer-alias-fake-exception is a sanctioned last-resort family (owner ruling 2026-07-01) requiring documented lever exhaustion + a named GCC-pass mechanism + a /* FAKE */ annotation; candidate.c supplies all three and the exhaustion record is stronger again after s5's four kills. New supporting fact from s5: q08/q09 show the pe62 alias is worth exactly -1 and only in the both-sides-through-the-pointer shape, i.e. it reproduces target's single materialised $t0 address and buys nothing else.
frontier.next_probe: Have the operator or the Judge run a fresh cheat-reviewer on memory/grind/replay_camera_Init/candidate.c. Three consecutive sessions have been unable to spawn one. A FAIL reverts the floor from 13 to 17 and changes the whole frontier, so it must not keep being deferred behind another search session.
